critique.evidence: Desktop is visually polished: the restrained grid, near-black palette, cyan/red semantic accents, bold headline, and routed evidence cards create a distinctive hierarchy. Mobile also reflows into a clean card stack with readable typography and appropriately stacked CTAs. However, the tablet viewport has a major presentation defect: the persistent header crosses and obscures the first headline line, while the navigation is visibly truncated. Its diagram also creates awkward vertical gaps and an imbalanced zigzag composition. Mobile shows no brand/navigation header at all, weakening continuity across viewports. These responsive inconsistencies prevent demo-ready polish.
critique.fix: Repair the tablet header/content offset so the full headline begins below the navigation, and collapse the long navigation into a compact menu before it truncates. Recompose the tablet evidence flow on a tighter grid with shorter connector paths and less dead space. Add a compact mobile brand/menu header, then verify consistent top spacing, title visibility, and navigation treatment at all three widths.
